source.title: Encoding Patterned Spatial Behavior in the Subiculum.

confidence_rationale: Review arguing the subiculum transforms granular hippocampal codes into memory SCHEMAS encoding environmental + task-imposed behavioural regularities, with subicular->mPFC outputs facilitating rule-guided action. Grounds a schema-cell substrate for the field's bottom-up 'in' face + the rule_state->mPFC output path. Held mid: review (not primary), spatial/behavioural schemas, mapping to a CandidateRule field is interpretive.
failure_signatures: Schemas here are spatial/behavioural-pattern regularities (boundaries, axes, pre/post-choice zones), not the affect-weighted, tolerance-gated CandidateRules ARC-063 specifies; the schema-to-rule mapping is interpretive.
It is a review synthesising existing findings, not a primary demonstration of a rule field; weight is conceptual.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The subiculum encodes regularities in environmental structure and task-imposed behavioural patterns, integrating hippocampal information into schematic representations for goal-directed action; theta-phase-specific fields segment space into pre/post-choice zones encoding context and choice, and subicular outputs to mPFC facilitate rule-guided action generation.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-063's distributed field has a bottom-up 'in' face (ARC-064: regularities extracted from behaviour become candidate rules) and must feed rule_state to mPFC (the SD-033a pathway GAP-B needs populated). The subiculum-as-schema-former, with subicular->mPFC outputs shaping rule-guided action, is a biological substrate for exactly that: hippocampal granular codes -> schematic regularities -> mPFC rule-guided action.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The schemas are spatial / behavioural-pattern regularities, not the affect-weighted, tolerance-gated, context-tagged CandidateRules ARC-063 specifies; and this is a review, so the grounding is conceptual rather than a direct rule-field demonstration.
mapping.source_context: Review of rodent subiculum electrophysiology (boundary/axis tuning, theta-phase choice-zone fields) and subiculum->mPFC anatomy.

confidence_components.notes: Review-level (lower source_quality than primary). Grounds the schema-substrate + hippocampal->mPFC rule-guided-action path conceptually; interpretive mapping.
